# ANALYSIS: V14E_GRINDER_KEEPERS_ASSESSMENT

## Hypothesis
Assess whether the 5 keepers from the v14_enhanced_grinder parameter sweep represent genuine edge or overfit, identify knob changes driving improvement vs baseline, note required OP-20 disclosures, and determine promotion readiness to leaderboard or need for OOS walk-forward testing.

## Mechanism
Examined provided grinder output (top keeper detailed, others implied by JSON truncation). Compared against OP-16 anchors and leaderboard. For top keeper, analyzed anchor day P&L and knob deltas vs V14E baseline. For other 4 keepers, lacked individual data.

## Conclusion
Top keeper fails OP-16 anchor requirement (edge_capture=$499.64 < $771 floor) and requires OOS walk-forward before further consideration. Other 4 keepers lack data for assessment. **None of the 5 keepers are ready for leaderboard promotion; all require Stage-1 backtest and OOS validation.** Recommend discarding top keeper for failing anchor days and treating all keepers as hypothesis-generating only pending rigorous OOS testing.
